My plot is very small, only 0.06 hectares, and I am growing beans intercropped with other crops. Here in Iringa the rains are good, so I do not need to irrigate. I cannot afford chemical fertilizer for such a small bean plot — beans also fix their own nitrogen, so I will just use some manure from home. I will use my own seeds saved from last season, and my family will do all the work ourselves without hiring anyone.
